values: 对目标敌人造成大量持续伤害，每次造成伤害时根据已损失生命值造成一定比例的额外伤害。
Shadewing deals heavy continuous damage to an enemy, and each hit deals extra damage based on the enemy's lost HP.
翼对目标敌人施加“血毒之羽”，持续10秒。“血毒之羽”持续期间，目标每秒受到翼60% + 8% ATK的基础伤害，并且附带目标当前已损失生命值5%的额外伤害。额外伤害最高不超过翼100% ATK。

Shadewing inflicts Crimson Venom on an enemy for 10s. While affected by Crimson Venom, the enemy takes damage every second equal to 60% + 8% ATK, plus extra damage equal to 5% of the enemy's lost HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 100% ATK.

翼将手刺入敌人胸口，造成70% ATK的伤害，拔出时再次造成70% ATK的伤害并撕裂其伤口，使目标在后续5秒内每秒受到翼120% + 20% ATK的伤害。

Shadewing sinks his claw into an enemy's chest, dealing 70% ATK damage. He then rips it free, tearing the wound open and dealing 70% ATK damage again. The enemy continues to take 120% + 20% ATK damage per second for the next 5s.
刺击造成的伤害增加至75% ATK，后续每秒造成的的伤害增加至140% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of the two claw strikes to 75% ATK and the damage dealt per second from the resulting wound to 140% + 20% ATK.
刺击造成的伤害增加至80% ATK，后续每秒造成的的伤害增加至160% + 20% ATK。

刺击造成的伤害增加至85% ATK，后续每秒造成的的伤害增加至180% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of the two claw strikes to 85% ATK and the damage dealt per second from the resulting wound to 180% + 20% ATK.
记录敌人受到的持续伤害，累计值满时爆发造成高额伤害。
Shadewing converts any continuous damage enemies take into curse value. Once the curse value reaches a set threshold, it lashes out, dealing heavy damage.

翼在战斗开始时会飞向敌方阵营并让全部敌人受到“蚀命羽咒”的影响，飞行过程中自身处于无敌状态。
 受到“蚀命羽咒”影响的敌人护甲和魔抗降低20%，在受到持续伤害时会将伤害记录为诅咒值。每当诅咒值累计达到其最大生命值20%时或者翼初始攻击力的400%时，诅咒爆发，对该敌人造成其最大生命值25% + 4%的伤害，爆发造成的伤害最高不会超过翼600% + 90% ATK。每名敌人诅咒爆发每3秒最多触发一次。

When a battle starts, Shadewing soars into the enemy formation, inflicting Withering Curse on all enemies. During the flight, Shadewing is invincible.
Withering Curse reduces enemies' Phys & Magic DEF by 20% and converts any continuous damage they take into curse value. When the curse value reaches the lesser of 20% of an enemy's max HP or 400% of Shadewing's initial ATK, the curse lashes out, dealing damage equal to 25% + 4% of the enemy's max HP. This damage cannot exceed 600% + 90% ATK. The curse lashes out at most once every 3s per enemy.
诅咒爆发时，造成的最大生命值的伤害提升至30% + 4%，伤害最高不会超过翼700% + 90% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when the curse lashes out to 30% + 4% of the enemy's max HP. This damage cannot exceed 700% + 90% ATK.
诅咒爆发时，造成的最大生命值的伤害提升至35% + 4%，伤害最高不会超过翼800% + 90% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when the curse lashes out to 35% + 4% of the enemy's max HP. This damage cannot exceed 800% + 90% ATK.
诅咒爆发时，造成的最大生命值的伤害提升至40% + 4%，伤害最高不会超过翼900% + 90% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when the curse lashes out to 40% + 4% of the enemy's max HP. This damage cannot exceed 900% + 90% ATK.

Shadewing recovers Energy and gains a permanent damage boost whenever Withering Curse lashes out or an enemy with Crimson Venom is defeated.

“蚀命羽咒”每次爆发时翼回复100能量，同时使自身造成的伤害永久提高6%，最多提高至36%。
敌人被击败时若携带“血毒之羽”，则翼会将其回收，“血毒之羽”每剩余1秒持续时间，便使翼回复50能量。

Every time Withering Curse lashes out, Shadewing recovers 100 Energy and permanently increases his damage dealt by 6%, up to 36%.
When an enemy with Crimson Venom is defeated, Shadewing reclaims the venom's residual essence and recovers 50 Energy for each second of Crimson Venom's remaining duration.
“蚀命羽咒”每次爆发时自身造成伤害提升的最高值提升至42%。
Increases the max damage boost Shadewing can gain from Withering Curse's lash to 42%.
“蚀命羽咒”爆发时造成伤害的85%转为真实伤害。
Converts 85% of the damage dealt by Withering Curse's lash into true damage.
“蚀命羽咒”每次爆发时自身造成伤害提升的最高值提升至48%。
Increases the max damage boost Shadewing can gain from Withering Curse's lash to 48%.
战斗开始时，扣除身前队友的生命值，使自身获得护盾和属性加成。
When a battle starts, Shadewing drains HP from the ally 1 tile in front of him to gain a shield and stat bonuses.
战斗开始时，翼夺取自己面前格队友的生命力，扣除其10%当前生命值，使翼获得30%攻击力加成以及30生命汲取，同时获得扣取生命值500%的护盾，最高不超过自身攻击力500%，持续到战斗结束。

When a battle starts, Shadewing targets the ally 1 tile in front of him and drains 10% of their current HP. He also gains a 30% ATK boost, 30 Life Drain, and a shield equal to 500% of the HP drained, up to 500% of his ATK. The effects last until the end of the battle.
